title: Review {building}
lead: Tell others what living here is like. Only people who lived here can review, and your name is never shown.

sent.title: Thank you — your review was sent
sent.body: The getproperty team checks it before it is published. You will see its state here.

tooEarly.title: Not yet
tooEarly.body: You can review this building from {date} — once you have lived here long enough, or after you move out.
tooEarly.bodyNoDate: You can review this building once you have lived here long enough, or after you move out.

not_started.title: No review for this lease
not_started.body: Only people who lived under this lease can review the building.

window_closed.title: The time to review has passed
window_closed.body: The time to review after moving out has passed.

too_early.title: Not yet
too_early.body: You can review this building later.

consent.heading: To publish your review
consent.english: This text is available in Thai and English only, so it is shown in English.

noConsent.title: Reviews are not available at the moment

rating.label: Your rating
rating.required: Choose a rating from 1 to 5 stars

body.label: Your review
body.placeholder: For example: clean building, fast lift, the office answers quickly; not much parking in the evening
body.personal: Please remove contact or account details: phone numbers, e-mail, LINE ids, links, bank accounts or ID numbers.

rules.title: Keep it about the building
rules.body: No phone numbers, e-mail, LINE ids, links, bank accounts or ID numbers — of you or anyone else. Reviews are checked before they are published.

consent.label: I agree to publish my review under the text above (version {version})
consent.hint: Optional. Without it, nothing is published.
consent.required: Tick the box to publish your review.

form.consentChanged: The text has just changed. Please read it again and tick the box.
form.notEligible: You cannot review this building yet.
form.notEligibleFrom: You can review this building from {date}.
form.moderation: The getproperty team checks reviews before they are published.

mine.title: My review
mine.rating: {count, plural, one {# star out of 5} other {# stars out of 5}}
mine.erased: The text was erased when you withdrew the review.

pending.title: Waiting for the getproperty team
pending.body: Your review is checked before it is published. Nobody else sees it yet.

published.title: Published
published.body: Your review is on this building's listings, marked as written by a verified resident, without your name or unit.

rejected.title: Not published
rejected.body: The getproperty team did not publish this review.
rejected.reason: The getproperty team did not publish this review: {reason}

hidden.title: Hidden
hidden.body: The getproperty team hid this review.
hidden.reason: The getproperty team hid this review: {reason}

withdrawn.title: Withdrawn
withdrawn.body: You withdrew this review. This lease cannot be reviewed again.

withdraw.title: Withdraw your review?
withdraw.body: The text is erased at once and the review leaves the building's rating. You cannot review this lease again.

entry.title: Review this building
entry.write: You lived here long enough to review it. Your name is never shown.
entry.wait: You can review this building once you have lived here long enough.
entry.waitFrom: You can review this building from {date}.
